protocol.input_selection: Copy saved posts-N.json to upstream/posts.json before each size; restore original 5000 fixture after completion.
protocol.timed: Original Rust Instant::now() span: string tag to post-index map construction, shared-tag counting, top-5 selection, output record construction.
protocol.excluded: File reading, runtime JSON parsing, serialization and writing occur outside original processing timer. External GNU time wall time includes these.
protocol.time_tool: GNU Time 1.9 built in isolated temporary prefix because no gtime installed. No global tool changes.
protocol.warmup: None, official run.sh sequence; initial run at each size includes cold effects.
limitations: Spotlight mdworker/mds consumed substantial CPU throughout setup; concurrent DEFLATE compiler work may occur on shared Mac mini.
Parent compiler build overlapped beginning of initial baseline due to coordination race; first 5k sample is visibly cold/noisy.
Initial baseline is exploratory, not final interleaved measurement.
Published upstream Linux table numbers are not directly comparable to Mac mini results.

generator_environment.adaptation: Source loaded with future annotations for Python3.9; random.seed(seed), Faker.seed(seed), nanoid.algorithm.urandom uses separate random.Random(seed+1) byte stream. Upstream source file unchanged.

correctness.independent_algorithm: Count all tag subsets across source posts. For each distinct tag shape, sum subset frequencies for size-k subsets, remove self C(m,k), then binomial-invert these moments to an exact shared-count histogram. Select five highest scores.
checks: Output count and order match input
Every full related post matches original input record
Sum of overlaps is globally optimal

small_fixtures.exact_unmodified_rust_indices: passed first-10, first-100, first-500, unicode-ties, empty-tags
small_fixtures.sparse_input_behavior: If fewer than five posts have positive overlap, original Rust fills the unused slots with post index zero. This can repeat a recommendation or recommend self on row zero. Exact fixture mode explicitly preserves it; full benchmark strict validation does not relax distinctness or self exclusion.

rules.tie_breaking: Verifier compares summed shared-tag counts; ties and order within related may differ.

vendored_artifacts.license_scope: Upstream MIT license applies to the original 5k dataset, derived first-n fixtures, upstream algorithm references, and generator source loaded from pinned git. Locally authored adapters and independent validator live under the Mech repository license.
vendored_artifacts.generator_reproduction: Portable vendored generator reproduced original 5000/20000/60000 dataset manifests byte-for-byte on mac-mini-runner.
